scope: Accounts runtime only. All login-item API calls are mocked, or scoped to synthetic SQLite/filesystem fixtures. No actual OS startup modification, user settings change, visible desktop control, new portable execution or OS reboot.

sources.title: Electron app login item API
verifiedClaims: getLoginItemSettings must receive the same path/args used for setLoginItemSettings.
openAtLogin=false removes the application login item.

sources.title: electron-builder NSIS portable environment
verifiedClaims: PORTABLE_EXECUTABLE_FILE is the portable executable path; DIR is its containing directory.

sources.title: Installed electron-builder portable launcher template
verifiedClaims: Template sets PORTABLE_EXECUTABLE_FILE from outer $EXEPATH and DIR from $EXEDIR.
ExecWait launches extracted child; the template then removes $INSTDIR.

change.portableTarget: Validated absolute PORTABLE_EXECUTABLE_FILE, regular EXE, outside canonical OS TEMP roots.
change.installedFallback: Existing non-temporary process.execPath when no portable metadata is present.
change.readback: Same path/args for setLoginItemSettings and getLoginItemSettings.
change.unknownOrDeletedPortable: Reject enabling before settings are committed; explicit disabling remains possible.

covered: Unicode/spaces and UNC target preserve empty arguments; pure runtime mocks perform no filesystem/network lookup.
Installed Program Files and per-user Programs fallback.
Canonical Windows short-path TEMP aliases rejected.
No writes for host apply without explicitStartupChange, restored settings, unrelated edits or duplicate action.
Explicit on/off and status reads agree on the target.
Real isolated AccountsService SQLite retains previous document/revision after enabling failure.
Moved/deleted launcher does not auto-change existing startup entries; explicit off still works.
pendingQa: 09 checks the rebuilt final portable package metadata, original EXE existence and selected path/args.
Mock API success is not actual Windows startup registration or OS reboot acceptance.
